verdict.rationale: Honeybadger documents a public exceptions-reporting API: a JSON payload POSTed to https://api.honeybadger.io/v1/notices, explicitly offered as a way to report errors directly. Companion APIs for source-map upload and deploy notification are also documented, so custom clients can send data without an official SDK. missing for 10: payload schema detail and auth specifics shown in the evidence, a machine-readable spec (OpenAPI probes all 404), evidence of third-party compatible SDKs or hands-on custom-client use.
